newsitem.title: Australia: Australian stocks seen firmer but RBA the key.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen firmer but RBA the key.

text.p: *Stocks seen stronger as U.S. firms, but Reserve Bank
interest rate decision still the key. "There should be something
in it for us with the U.S. quite strong," said a Sydney broker.
*Wall Street finished higher, powered by a strong bond market performance after economic data showed moderate growth.
*ADRs: News Corp 19-1/4 (steady), BHP 29-3/4 (steady), WMC 25-3/4 (+1/8), National Australia Bank 71-7/8 (+9/16)
*Gold price hits four year lows. On LME, zinc charged higher but the rest of the complex was mixed with copper and tin softer while but with aluminium, nickel and lead firmer.
